newsitem.title: FRANCE: Synthelabo '96 net attrib rises 19.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Synthelabo '96 net attrib rises 19.7 pct.

text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)

NOTE - Synthelabo, a unit of L'Oreal, gave the provisional results in a statement. It said adjusted net attributable profit was before capital gains or losses, before tax and before goodwill writedown.

The 24.8 percent rise in operating profit after the part reverting to joint venture partner Searle reflects growth in sales and an improvement in gross margins related to a strong performance by strategic products, especially Stilnox in the United States. Given the increase in net financial expense, tax, employee profit sharing and minority interest, adjusted net attributable profit rose 19.7 percent, it said.
